thesis: Financially clean Navratna PSU consultancy (debt-free, 95% dividend payout, every engine gate passes, Z'' 4.68 safe) riding a record Rs 9,416cr order book with export revival real (Mozambique done, Bangladesh rakes shipping, $35.8m South Africa order). The engine finds no distress — the problem is purely price: Rs 209 vs Rs 174 DCF fair value, 25x earnings on a business guiding profit growth to lag revenue. Quality company, wrong price; the ACC trigger at Rs 144 is the line to watch.
